tools.name: search_vulnerabilities
tools.description: Search the KEVWire corpus (CISA KEV, NVD high/critical CVEs, GitHub advisories, national CERTs, security reporting, editorial records) by words, technology, kind or exploitation. Use it to answer "is X affected" or "what is known about Y"; for a known ID use get_record, and for a plain "what is bein

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Fetch one record by CVE ID, GHSA ID, or KEVWire record ID, with every source, measurement date, CISA deadline and a permalink. Any published CVE resolves, even outside the tracked set. Returns isError with a hint when nothing matches; then try search_vulnerabilities.

tools.name: list_recent_exploited
tools.description: Vulnerabilities with documented exploitation (CISA KEV or explicit reporting) published within the last N days, most urgent first. Use it for briefings such as "what was exploited this week"; to narrow by product or words, use search_vulnerabilities with known_exploited_only. Paged with offset and h

tools.name: list_technologies
tools.description: Technology labels (vendors and products) usable in search_vulnerabilities' technologies filter, with how many records each covers, most covered first. Use it to find the exact label before filtering. Optionally filter by text.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Every source KEVWire ingests, with scope, limitations, retrieval status, last success and record counts. Use it to describe coverage honestly or to explain why something may be missing.
